Name: (CP)swy Spring Advent
Author: Yvbie
Description:
————9.19————
加入了包括壁纸和地板在内的42款来自游戏食物语中云华引春阁的家具。加入的两款壁纸，一款是木韵流芳的壁纸，另外一款是云华引春的壁纸。地板是云华引春的地板。
Added 42 furniture items from the Food Fantasy "Spring's Advent" series, including wallpapers and flooring. Among the newly added wallpapers, one is from the "Woodland Harmony" set, and the other is from the "Ethereal Spring" collection. The flooring also belongs to the "Spring's Advent" set.

Manifest.Name: Spring's Advent
Manifest.Description: A set of decorative furniture from Spring's Advent(a furniture collection in the game Food Fantasy) that can be placed both indoors and outdoors
Manifest.Author: YVbie
